q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in China. I usually do sports with my classmates after school, and sometimes with my dad at the weekend. In winter I like skating and running, because they keep me warm. At school we have PE lessons twice a week. We play basketball and do running, and last week we played volleyball. I really enjoy it because I can play with my friends. I don’t like rainy weather because I can’t go outside to play. When the weather is hot, I enjoy swimming and eating ice cream with my friends.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如和谁一起运动、冬天喜欢什么运动、学校里上什么体育课、最不喜欢什么天气），用简单而正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like going to parties because I can dance and see my friends. Going shopping is cool, but it can be expensive. Going away on holiday is special because you can visit new places. I don’t think watching cartoons is boring; they are funny and help me relax. Going for a long walk is healthy because it is good exercise, but it can be tiring. I like going away on holiday best. I think dancing is more fun than listening to music, because you can move and laugh with your friends. On holiday I prefer doing lots of activities, like swimming and visiting museums, because being lazy is boring for me.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图片中的每种娱乐活动表明喜欢与否并给出理由，能回答考官的追问（聚会、购物、度假、看动画片、长距离散步），说出最喜欢哪一种，并用 because 等连接词展开。
